description_en: Retrieves the historical prices of spot instances

kebab_example: aliyun paistudio get-spot-price-history --instance-type ml.gu7xf.8xlarge-gu108 --spot-duration 0 --start-time 2024-12-26T09:36:46Z --end-time 2024-12-30T09:36:46Z --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by GmtCreatedTime --order asc --api-version 2022-01-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSpotPriceHistory

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the spot instance. ECS instance types and Lingjun instance types are supported
parameters.help_zh: 抢占式实例的实例规格。支持ECS规格和灵骏规格
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The protection period of the spot instance. Unit: hours. Note that only ECS instance types support Settings for the protection period of spot instances. Default value: 0. Valid values:

1: After the spot instance is created, Alibaba Cloud ensures that the instance runs for 1 hour without automatic release. After 1 hour, the system automatically compares the bid price with the marketplace price and checks resource inventory to determine whether to retain or revoke the instance.
0: After the spot instance is created, Alibaba Cloud does not guarantee that the instance runs for 1 hour. The system automatically compares the bid price with the marketplace price and checks resource inventory to determine whether to retain or revoke the instance
parameters.help_zh:
抢占式实例的保留时长，单位为小时。 注意目前仅ECS规格支持设置抢占式实例保留时长，默认值：0。取值范围：
1：创建后阿里云会保证实例运行1小时不会被自动释放；超过1小时后，系统会自动比较出价与市场价格、检查资源库存，来决定实例的持有和回收。
0：创建后，阿里云不保证实例运行1小时，系统会自动比较出价与市场价格、检查资源库存，来决定实例的持有和回收
parameters.name: spot_duration

parameters.help_en: The start time for querying the historical prices of spot instances. The maximum value cannot exceed 7 days before the specified end time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. Default value: null, which indicates 3 days before the end time
parameters.help_zh: 查询抢占式实例历史价格的起始时间，最大值不得超过指定的结束时间7天。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。默认值：空，空代表结束时间前3天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for querying the historical prices of spot instances. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. Default value: null, which indicates the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询抢占式实例历史价格的结束时间。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。默认值：空，空表示当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: *1*. This parameter takes effect only when you query the historical prices of Lingjun instance types
parameters.help_zh: 分页参数：当前页码，默认值*1*。仅查询灵骏规格的历史价格时该参数生效
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. This parameter takes effect only when you query the historical prices of Lingjun instance types
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小。默认值：10。仅查询灵骏规格的历史价格时该参数生效
